$comment: Copy this to <key>.json and fill it in. This is the ONLY file a new project authors. Everything else — rules, agents, hooks, permissions, paths — comes from the adapter baseline.
owner: <a person, not a team — replace before compose>
repo: <path or URL of the repo this composes into>
$pattern: Declare the architecture the existing repo actually uses, not the one you wish it used. Run Phase 0 of the bootstrapper (Pattern Triage) to detect it from the repo before filling this in. Valid values: command-first (cy.* custom commands own all UI logic), helper-first (helper classes + fixtures), pom (page-object classes), bdd-pom (Gherkin features over page objects), data-driven (fixture/table-driven cases over a shared layer).
$patternReason: Required when onboarding an existing repo. State the concrete signals that determined the pattern — e.g. '12 of 14 spec files import from pages/, confirming POM'. This is the audit trail that lets the next person understand why ARCH-BOUNDARY does or does not apply.
patternReason: <evidence that determined the pattern — file signals, import patterns, respondent data>
$patternDivergence: Optional. List aspects of the codebase that do not fit the declared pattern. These are violations to fix under the detected rules, not exceptions to the rules. Example: '3 spec files embed hardcoded selectors — SELECTOR rule will block these on next commit'.
$adapters: ASK THE TEAM. Which AI coding tools will actually be used here? Enable each one the team uses; disabling one removes its generated files on the next sync, so a Claude-only team stops carrying files it never opens. At least one must stay enabled. Claude, Copilot, and Cursor refuse a violating write via PreToolUse/preToolUse (exit 2). Codex has no hook API — its gate is `npm run verify` and the pre-push hook. See docs/architecture/cross-tool-configuration.md.
$overrides: Optional. Omit the whole block to take adapter defaults. Only add a key here when this project genuinely differs — an override you did not need is config that will drift.

overrides.$context: Model effort and memory. Adapter default is high + alwaysThinking + autoMemory.
overrides.$loops: Bounded repair. Adapter default is gateRepairLimit 3.
